title: Talk to Gemini with your voice

body.text: voice input — talking to it directly
. Just tap the microphone button and speak; Gemini converts your voice to text and replies. Great for when typing isn't convenient.

example: "[Tap the mic] Make me a to-do list for today: I have a meeting, a report to send, and a client to call."

title: Analyze video with Gemini

body.text: analyze video content and answer questions about what happens in the clip
— summarizing the content, pointing out key moments, or explaining how things shown in the video are done.

example: "[Attach a meeting video] Summarize the points agreed on and the action items in this video."
